lines: Ab ke hum bichhde to shayad kabhi khwabon mein milen
couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps we will meet again in dreams.

lines: Jis tarah sookhe hue phool kitabon mein milen
couplets.en: Like dried flowers we come upon between the pages of a book.

lines: Ab ke hum bichhde to shayad kabhi khwabon mein milen
couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps we will meet again in dreams.

lines: Dhoond ujade hue logon mein wafa ke moti
couplets.en: Seek the pearls of devotion among those whose lives lie in ruins.

lines: Ye khazane tujhe mumkin hai kharabon mein milen
couplets.en: Among the ruins, you may yet find these treasures.

lines: Tu khuda hai na mera ishq farishton jaisa
couplets.en: You are no god, and there is nothing angelic about my love.

lines: Dono insaan hain to kyun itne hijabon mein milen
couplets.en: We are both human, so why meet behind so many veils?

lines: Jis tarah sookhe hue phool kitabon mein milen
couplets.en: Like dried flowers we come upon between the pages of a book.

lines: Ab ke hum bichhde to shayad kabhi khwabon mein milen
couplets.en: If we part this time, perhaps we will meet again in dreams.

lines: Gham-e-duniya bhi gham-e-yaar mein shamil kar lo
couplets.en: Let the world's sorrow mingle with the sorrow of longing for you.

lines: Nasha badhta hai sharaben jo sharabon mein milen
couplets.en: The intoxication deepens when wines are mingled.
